solutions.title: Array sort rebuild
solutions.strategy: Copy values into an array, sort them, and rebuild the list from the sorted values.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting the copied values dominates the traversal and rebuild work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The value array and rebuilt nodes store n items.

solutions.title: Linked-list merge sort
solutions.strategy: Split the list with slow and fast pointers, recursively sort both halves, then merge nodes in order.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each level merges all nodes and there are logarithmically many split levels.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursive call stack stores one frame per split level while nodes are relinked in place.
